Subject: Renewal: isolation + new VPC seed for analytics cluster

Maya / Karthik,

We’re starting renewal planning for our Redwood contract (expiring mid-August) and want to gate the renewal conversation on a concrete plan for an additional private VPC used by our analytics and reporting teams. Key asks: a physically isolated VPC (no shared kube control plane with prod), two additional clusters for batch inference (initially small, burst-capable), and the option to flex capacity up within the first 90 days without renegotiating pricing.

I attached a short spreadsheet with the expected peak Q4 token load and a rough rollout timeline (MedFabrica_Scaling_Requirements.xlsx). Our security folks will need a sketch of network isolation and KMS integration for the new environment. Procurement would like a single amendment that covers: term extension (12 months), staged invoicing, and a capped uplift for the seeded clusters.

Can you propose a mutual action plan (MAP) and a rough price delta? Happy to set a call next week — our SRE lead (cc’d in procurement thread) will be on the call.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
VP, Infrastructure
MedFabrica Health

Subject: Re: Renewal: isolation + new VPC seed for analytics cluster

Maya / Ben — quick technical note for the MAP and for Sanjay’s security team.

Summary recommendations (short):
- Provision two new private clusters (cluster-a-analytics, cluster-b-analytics), each initially 3x A100-equivalent vGPU nodes in a burst-capable pool. This maps to the token volumes in the spreadsheet and allows autoscaling on burst windows.
- Network isolation: separate VPC, no shared control plane, dedicated peering for observability only. KMS/HSM integration supported via customer-managed keys; we will provide HSM keywrap docs and a short runbook.
- Costing: staged seed pricing = base monthly for the two clusters + a reserved commit for 50% of projected baseline. Uplift for immediate burst-ups can be billed as variable usage at a pre-agreed capped multiplier (e.g., 1.35x baseline on add-ons) to avoid later renegotiation.
- Rollout plan: seed Day 0, validation and gating for Stage 2 at Day 45, optional scale to target by Day 90.

I’m attaching a capacity breakdown with node-level pricing and an example reserve commitment that maps to their Q4 ramp (capacity_breakdown.csv).

If Sanjay’s team wants, I can produce a 1-page security sketch for their SOC person with the KMS flow and log retention.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Proposal: amendment sketch + next steps (RDW-4521)

Sanjay — following up with a concrete amendment sketch and next actions so procurement can move forward.

Key points of the proposal (high level):
- Term: 12 months starting on signature date; existing services to continue until cutover for new env.
- Seed: Two private clusters provisioned at contract start (Cluster-A / Cluster-B) sized per Karthik’s recommended node pools.
- Flexible expansion: Option to add up to 3 additional cluster nodes in the first 90 days without renegotiation; any beyond that are subject to the defined capped uplift.
- Pricing: One-time provisioning fee (covers environment setup & network isolation), monthly reserved commit covering 50% baseline, and variable usage billed monthly with a capped multiplier for burst adds. Detailed numbers are in the attached amendment draft.
- Security/compliance: We’ll provide the KMS integration runbook and a SOC checklist.

Action items:
1) Sanjay: confirm MAP items and approve the amendment draft for legal review.
2) Procurement: confirm billing cadence and PO flow — we can support staged invoicing.
3) Redwood: Karthik will publish the 1-page security sketch; I’ll open the DocuSign envelope once we align on final numbers.

I’ve attached the amendment draft (term_amend_draft_4521.pdf). If this aligns with your needs, I’ll schedule a short procurement/legal review for Friday.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround here.

Best regards,
